review_candidates.description: Company Description FETRA INTEGRITY Egypt is a management and human capital consulting company focused on enhancing organizational performance through tailored people strategies. The company provides end-to-end HR and project management services, including recruitment, organization design and restructuring, and competency and job modeling. FETRA INTEGRITY Egypt also specializes in performance management, succession planning, and total reward management, such as job evaluation, pay strategies, and salary structures. In addition, the organization offers payroll administration, social and medical insurance services, outsourcing solutions, training needs analysis, and career counseling to support clients in achieving optimal workforce effectiveness. Role Description The AP Accounting Supervisor – Real Estate will oversee the accounts payable function for real estate projects and ensure accurate and timely processing of vendor invoices, expense claims, and payments. This full-time, on-site role based in Qesm 1st New Cairo will involve supervising AP staff, reviewing and approving journal entries, monitoring accruals, and reconciling vendor accounts. The supervisor will coordinate with project management and finance teams to validate costs, ensure proper coding and allocation to projects, and maintain compliance with internal controls and company policies. The role will also include preparing AP-related reports, supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, and contributing to process improvements within the AP and project accounting workflows. Qualifications Strong supervisory skills, including team leadership, workload management, and performance oversight. Analytical skills to review invoices, accruals, and financial data and to resolve discrepancies effectively. Solid finance and accounting knowledge, with practical experience in accruals and journal entries (accounting). Previous experience in accounts payable within the real estate or construction sector, ideally with project-based accounting. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certification (e.g., CPA, CMA) is an advantage. Proficiency in accounting software and MS Excel, including reconciliations and reporting tools. High attention to detail, strong numerical aptitude, and ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with internal stakeholders, vendors, and project teams. Knowledge of relevant local regulations and compliance requirements related to AP and financial reporting.

review_candidates.title: Platform Engineer (Backend Infrastructure)
review_candidates.description: Position: Infrastructure Engineer Location : Poland/Europe - Remote Type : This can be structured as a B2B contract or Employment Contract with full benefits Poland B2B Annual Rate : $102,000 - $117,500 depending on experience + stock options Portugal Salary Band: €60,000 - €72,000 depending on experience + stock options Who We Are Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are a Silicon Valley-based startup headquartered in San Francisco, with operations in Canada, the UK, multiple EU countries and a tech hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning-first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world, processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of stores globally. We were recently named Confluent's inaugural Data Streaming Startup of the Year, a recognition of how seriously we take the engineering challenges at the core of our business. We seek smart, creative, and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company. What We're Looking For We are looking for a Platform Engineer to own the platform that every image from every store passes through: ingestion, Kafka streaming, Python services, GPU model inference, databases, storage, and the GCP and Kubernetes layer underneath. The team is small, so there is no separate SRE, DBA or release team. When a pipeline slows down, you find out whether the cause is a Kafka consumer, a MySQL query, an autoscaler or a node pool, and you fix it, including in the application code. The role is cloud-only, with no on-prem or datacenter hardware, and CI/CD pipelines are a small part of it. The core challenge is scale. We are processing hundreds of millions of images per day across tens of thousands of retail locations globally, and that number is growing fast. Load will grow by an order of magnitude, and your job is to make sure cost and operational effort do not grow with it. What You Will Do Own the design, operation and cost of Focal's production platform on GCP: Kubernetes, Kafka, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, object storage. Drive measurable reductions in COGS and latency, for example lowering GPU inference cost per store through machine types, batching, autoscaling or scheduling, and report the numbers. Read, debug and change Python (FastAPI, Kafka consumers) backend services. Platform problems are often fixed in application code, for example a MySQL query that ran fine at 1,000 stores and times out at 10,000. Fix throughput bottlenecks such as consumer lag at store opening, whether the cause is partition count, consumer throughput, a downstream database or autoscaling reaction time. Rework metrics, alerts and dashboards so the on-call engineer can tell which stores and regions are affected when an alert fires. Take part in incident response, postmortems and capacity planning. Build tooling that gives engineers access to data across regions and storage systems in minutes instead of days. Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm) and the deployment path to production, and work with the backend, deep learning and edge teams so the platform keeps up with new products and models. What You Need to Be Successful Must have Python as a software engineer, not only for scripting. You will contribute to backend code every week. 5+ years building and operating production backend systems on a cloud platform. GCP preferred; deep AWS or Azure experience is fine. Hands-on production experience operating at least one stateful system under load: Kafka or another streaming platform, MySQL/PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. We mean partitioning, replication, lag, slow queries and failover, not only provisioning. Kubernetes in production, including scheduling, resource limits, autoscaling with KEDA, GPU node pools and debugging misbehaving pods. Debugging production incidents across layers (application, messaging, database, orchestration, network), with examples you can walk us through. Observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Grafana Mimir and Sentry, or equivalent: instrumenting code, writing useful alerts. Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool. Nice to have MySQL query tuning; Kafka internals (consumer group rebalancing, partition strategy, throughput tuning), Confluent Cloud and Kafka Connect. GPU workloads or ML inference serving in production (Ray/KubeRay or similar), and cloud cost optimization with measured results. Go, Snowflake, Airflow, CircleCI, Helm, and blue/green or canary releases. About You You take ownership of problems end to end and follow them into whichever layer they lead. You make decisions from data (profiles, metrics, query plans, cost reports) and prioritize well in startup/scaleup environments. Advanced written and spoken English. Comfortable coordinating across time zones with a global team. Comfortable with a shared on-call rotation. Why Focal Systems Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception. Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art. Outstanding Partners - We work with some of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors. What we offer We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer: Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock Paid Time Off Team Retreats Education grants Note: Our pay bands are driven by market benchmarks in the target geography for hiring. Our posted ranges typically include multiple job levels. A candidate's level is determined by their performance throughout our talent acquisition process including technical screens, behavior interviews, presentations, work samples, and references. We will communicate transparently with the candidate at final stages regarding how we have leveled them, and what salary range that places them into. Placement within range is equally determined by education, general experience in your profession, specific experience in our domain, and your performance in the talent acquisition process. It is rare to receive an offer at the top of the range for a role.

Working across a range of communication channels, you'll engage with customers and colleagues in a professional, empathetic, and customer-focused manner, helping to create a frictionless experience at every touchpoint. You'll also be passionate about continuous improvement, collaborating with internal teams to identify opportunities to enhance processes, improve service delivery, and drive positive outcomes for customers. Above all, you'll embody Bupa's values by treating every customer fairly, respectfully, and with genuine care, ensuring they receive the outstanding service they deserve. How You’ll Help Us Make Health Happen Ensure operational excellence by maintaining accurate records, managing the customers journey and supporting colleagues Handle data with the upmost care to protect the privacy of Bupa customers Ensure compliance with all operational control standards including governance and legal requirements Complete all tasks accurately and efficiently within desired timeframe Be a proactive problem-solver, identifying and resolving issues before they impact the customer Ensure compliance of mandatory Bupa Learn courses at all times Communicate with customers & colleagues in a professional, proactive and timely manner through a variety of systems Ensure that specialist knowledge of any new emerging process is kept up to date by engaging in training and service communications. Key Skills / Qualifications Needed For This Role PC literate, excellent knowledge of MS office packages. Customer service experience and highly customer focussed. We make health happen by being brave, caring and responsible in everything we do. We encourage all of our people to “Be you at Bupa”, we champion diversity, and we understand the importance of our people representing the communities and customers we serve. That’s why we especially encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. This role is for engineers who like hard distributed systems problems, write Go every day, and want their code to manage real customer databases in production. Work closely with other teams (Operations, Platform, and Billing & IAM teams, Product and Support). Strong understanding of distributed systems: consistency, failure handling, replication. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP or Azure). Experience designing APIs (gRPC or REST) and with CI/CD and automated testing. Comfortable participating in on-call rotations and handling production incidents. Ownership mindset and clear communication skills. Nice to have Experience running stateful workloads or databases on Kubernetes. Background in database, storage or DBaaS products. Experience with backup, replication or disaster recovery systems. Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or similar tooling. Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Kubernetes ecosystem. Why join us A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure. A competitive salary with additional perks. Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture. High ownership and real impact. Open-source, engineering-driven culture. Choose your own laptop equipment. For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy. Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
